notes.title: v1.30: Performance & Smoothing Update
notes.notes:
v1.29 changes the fog model to improve consistency & performance. Object caching & pooling was improved, which should reduce early game framerate consistency. Finally, a custom physics interpolation system was put in place for character movement, which should hopefully reduce movement jitter.

v1.30 fixes positioning in VR & LightSword tracking.

These updates are now on the default branch.

notes.title: Update v1.28: Fixed Explosions
notes.notes:
v1.28 uses a new explosion design that should suffer from the same performance problems when viewed up-close as in previous versions.

This update also includes the v1.27 stun changes that have been in beta for some time.

notes.title: Update v1.27: bots in all areas & further stun tweaks
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Now all areas will have at least some bots. There no longer will be "turret only" areas
[*]Increased the time you cannot be stunned again, to reduce the perception of "stun lock"
[/list]

This update is currently on the beta branch.

notes.title: Update v1.26: Stunner Adjustment
notes.notes: This update changes the way enemies use the stunning ability. Before, stuns were used against targets the moment they were noticed. Now, enemies will only use stuns offensively while attacking. Enemies only attack when targets are fully discovered. For example, an enemy bot won't stun you until they are also shooting at you (and the eye above their head is solid red). Now you can use stealthy mechanics to avoid being stunned!

notes.title: Update v1.25: Gameplay Tweaks
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Increased Station Finder time from 20 to 30 seconds
[*]Increased time before items despawn when dropped
[*]Increased size & height of platforms on the acidic floor
[/list]

notes.title: v1.24: VR Movement Options
notes.notes:
v1.24 adds an option for "coupled" head movement. This shall make you move in the direction you are looking at all times, instead of "decoupled" movement where you walk in the direction pressed on the touchpad (relative to where you were looking when starting to move).

The default is "decoupled" movement, which was the only "free movement" mode before this update.

You can change this option in the main menu options when playing in VR.

notes.title: ROMBIE v1.19: Important fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Jobs that can't find targets (likely in small areas) will now properly report a failure message instead of causing unstable behavior
[*]Gun names are now properly saved (old saves will still have "gun" as the name)
[*]Reduced volume of player damage sounds
[*]Tweaked movement code to hopefully reduce stutter in high frame rate scenarios
[/list]

This update, now on the default branch, includes the v1.18 fix.

notes.title: ROMBIE v1.17: 2-sensor Oculus option & fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added an option to replace the Left Grip button's function of changing your selected ability (which you can still do with your right Grip) with resetting your view. This should allow players without a 360-degree setup to play ROMBIE by turning their heads & hitting the new enabled "reset your view" Grip button. I still highly recommend a 360-degree setup, though.
[*]Updated to Unity v5.6.5p3
[*]Fixed negative repair values at Repair stations
[*]Fixed inconsistent in-game & Main Menu settings
[/list]
